_comment: Per-host PUBLISHED instruction-budget limit, against which the installed-layer report measures what a consumer actually loads. road-to-an-installed-layer-that-is-thinned steps 1.4 and 3.5. Loader and the 80 % warning fraction: src/scripts/_lib/installed_layer.ts. A host with no limit this tree can cite carries `limit: null`, which renders as `no published limit` and fires NO warning — an absent limit is an absent measurement, never a pass. NOTHING HERE MAY BE INVENTED: every non-null `limit` carries a `source` naming where the figure is recorded, and `kind` says what sort of record that is. `vendor-published` means a figure this tree read from the host's own published material; `reported` means a figure recorded in this repository from an observation, which is weaker and is marked so a later reader does not promote it by mistake.

Promote to `vendor-published` only against the host's own published material, never against another copy of this entry.
